title: An exception marker licenses a local rule override
summary: Test whether a recurring whole marks an exception to an otherwise repeated local procedure, rather than naming a special material or state.

design.mechanism: The candidate scopes over a bounded exception and predicts a deliberate departure from the immediately established rule.
design.unit: candidate occurrences after a repeated rule pattern with a following divergent field
design.contrast: exception-marked divergence versus matched unmarked divergence and ordinary rule continuation
design.prediction: Candidate contexts show a higher rate of one bounded rule override followed by return or closure, while ordinary divergence lacks that pattern; a material/state reading predicts no override signature.
design.falsifier: No held override-and-return contrast, or divergence is equally common without the candidate, falsifies exception scope.
design.scope: cached repeated record patterns; endpoint availability_unknown for independent rule/exception coding
design.related: Different from line breaks, closure, and result latency; requires a predeclared rule pattern and no post-hoc exception labels
